note: General self-care only, each item traceable to its source. No medicines here: the patient's own prescription is surfaced separately and always comes first. Symptoms with an empty list get no home-care advice at all (NHS gives none / says see a doctor).

items.en: Rest and try to relax — stress can make headaches worse.
items.hi: Thoda aaram kijiye aur relax karne ki koshish kijiye — tension se sir dard badh sakta hai.
Kuch der phone aur screen se aankhon ko aaram dijiye.

items.en: Drink plenty of fluids — water is best.
items.hi: Khoob paani aur taral cheezein lijiye — paani sabse achha hai.

items.en: Take small, regular sips of a cold drink.
items.hi: Thanda paani thoda-thoda karke ghoont mein piyiye.

items.en: Avoid strong-smelling, fried or greasy food.
items.hi: Tez khushboo wala, tala hua ya bahut tel wala khana mat khaiye.

items.en: Take small, regular sips of water to avoid dehydration.
items.hi: Paani ki kami na ho, isliye thoda-thoda paani ghoont mein piyiye.

items.en: Lie down until the dizziness passes, then get up slowly.
items.hi: Chakkar jaane tak let jaiye, phir dheere se uthiye.

items.en: Drink plenty of fluids, especially water.
Don't drive or use machinery while dizzy.
items.hi: Chakkar ke dauraan gaadi mat chalaiye aur machine ka kaam mat kijiye.

items.en: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth or pad.
items.hi: Saaf kapde ya pad se ghaav par zor se dabaiye.
